spuInfo.refundReturn:
We strive to provide a smooth shopping experience. If you're not completely satisfied with your purchase, you can return or exchange the item under the following conditions. Please retain the original packaging， fillers and ensure the item is unused and unassembled.

 

30-Day Return Policy

General Return

-Initiate a return within 30 days of receipt.

-Item must be:

  1. In brand-new condition
  2. Uninstalled and/or non-assembled
  3. Unused with no pieces missing
  4. With original tags and complete original packaging

-Return shipping costs are at your expense unless the item has a quality issue.

 

*For more reasons to keep the original packaging, Refunds & Replacements’ page .

 

Non-Returnable Items

  1. Items without original packaging, fillers and the crate/wooden box.
  2. Clearance items
  3. Customized items
  4. Offline purchases
  5. Items marked ‘Non-Returnable’
  6. Assembled or disassembled products

 

Before You Start a General Return

- Keep all original packaging and materials.

- Take a full view picture of the product and its original packaging for eligibility assessment.

 

Faulty or Damaged Products

- Report any issues within 48 hours of receipt.

- Include photos or a video to demonstrate the problem.

- Email to ‘supportingcenter@povison.com’.

Additional Terms

- Undeliverable and Refused Packages may incur additional fees (e.g. fail to deliver due to packaging size limitations, or COI (Certificate of Insurance) restrictions to apartment building, or unable to contact the customer during delivery, etc).

- Damaged items should be reported within 48 hours of receipt.

 

How to Return an Item?

  1. Email `supportingcenter@povison.com` with your order ID and details, photos/videos showing the package and item.
  2. Wait for our product expert to evaluate your return and return cost.
  3. Once confirmed, we'll send you a return label.
  4. Ship the package back to us for processing.

 

Refund Policy

- Receive a notification within 5 working days after we receive your item(s).

- Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

 

*For credit card payments, please allow up to one billing cycle for your account to be credited.

 

---

 

For more information, Refunds & Replacements’ page .

description.whyLove: Featuring a sleek sailboat design, this sofa boasts an adjustable backrest that seamlessly transforms between a stylish sofa and a comfy bed. With a depth adjustment of 24 inches forward and 35.5 inches backward, it adapts to all your lounging and sleeping needs. Sailboat Sofa, revolutionizing comfort and adaptability in your living space.

noteAndCare.Note:
1.Natural materials will vary subtly in color tone, surface texture, and veining. Natural variations are not considered product defects. (Normal use is not affected.)

2.Due to the difference between shooting lights and display resolutions, there may be chromatic aberrations between the picture and the real object and the picture on our website is for reference only.

3.Since the dimensions of our products are manually measured, there may be an error of ± 0.79 inch between the real product and the measurement data. The measurement data is for reference only.
noteAndCare.Product Care:
1.Lightly pat with a wooden stick outdoors to remove dust from the velvet chair, but avoid long sun exposure to prevent fading and keep away from moisture.

2.Wipe the surface with a damp, wrung-out white towel if the chair can't be moved. Avoid dark ink stains, and use fabric cleaner for regular dirt.

3.Roll a lint remover over dusty areas or use a vacuum cleaner for quick, targeted cleaning—ideal for spots with heavy dust buildup.

4.Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. To protect finish, avoid the use of chemicals and household cleaners. Hardware may loosen over time. Periodically check that all connections are tight.

noteAndCare.Product Care:
1.Lightly pat with a wooden stick outdoors to remove dust from the velvet chair, but avoid long sun exposure to prevent fading and keep away from moisture.

2.Wipe the surface with a damp, wrung-out white towel if the chair can't be moved. Avoid dark ink stains, and use fabric cleaner for regular dirt.

3.Roll a lint remover over dusty areas or use a vacuum cleaner for quick, targeted cleaning—ideal for spots with heavy dust buildup.

4.Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. To protect finish, avoid the use of chemicals and household cleaners. Hardware may loosen over time. Periodically check that all connections are tight.

noteAndCare.Product Care:
1.Lightly pat with a wooden stick outdoors to remove dust from the velvet chair, but avoid long sun exposure to prevent fading and keep away from moisture.

2.Wipe the surface with a damp, wrung-out white towel if the chair can't be moved. Avoid dark ink stains, and use fabric cleaner for regular dirt.

3.Roll a lint remover over dusty areas or use a vacuum cleaner for quick, targeted cleaning—ideal for spots with heavy dust buildup.

4.Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. To protect finish, avoid the use of chemicals and household cleaners. Hardware may loosen over time. Periodically check that all connections are tight.
